title: STARFM workflow: Landsat-like reflectance from Landsat 8/9 with MODIS or VIIRS, with built-in temporal baselines

description: An open, provenance-tracked workflow that automates the spatial and temporal adaptive reflectance fusion model (STARFM) for Landsat 8/9 Collection 2 surface reflectance with daily MODIS or VIIRS reflectance: data discovery and download, daily nadir-view BRDF normalization with a land-cover fallback, registration, execution of the original USDA-ARS STARFM program (v1.2.2, CC0), held-out Landsat validation, and scoring against nearest-date persistence and linear temporal interpolation on identical pixels. Campaigns of hundreds of predictions run as Slurm job arrays with cross-node cache locks, resumable retries and recorded failure causes.
